Payout of 8 July is short ₹482.29.
The bank credited ₹2,08,236.60 against an expected ₹2,08,718.89. 12 orders sit in this payout. No refund, chargeback or payment in the gateway ledger accounts for the difference, so the cause is not yet identified.
Suggested action: request the gateway's own breakdown for this payout, and check for a dispute debited but not yet reported.
